content: My day has been pretty busy working on the computer and chatting with learners like you, Gourav. How about you, did you do anything fun or interesting today?
I want to practise a 3-minute presentation on "How to prepare for a job interview". Please ask me to give my opening, then give feedback on my grammar and structure.
That sounds like a great topic, Gourav! Whenever you're ready, go ahead and start with your opening.
That's a nice start! Whenever you're ready, please continue with the next part of your introduction.
